consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the performance on February 3, 1979, at Market Square Arena is highlighted by an exceptional Scarlet > Fire and a strong China > Rider. Despite some criticisms regarding the sound quality, many reviewers praise the energy and musicianship displayed throughout the show.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.4 for 58 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans celebrate the standout performances, there are significant critiques regarding the sound quality and some unevenness in the first set.
